name: Run MRIQC on Functional Data - FMRI
summary: Runs MRIQC 22.0.6 on a functional (BOLD) image to compute image quality metrics and produce an individual HTML QC report and a table of quality metrics.
description: Wraps the functional (BOLD) image into a single-subject BIDS dataset and runs MRIQC 22.0.6 at the participant level (no group-level stage). Outputs the full MRIQC derivatives, the subject HTML report and a TSV of the image quality metrics (IQMs) for use as regressors or for screening scans. Use it to screen data quality before preprocessing.

outputs.description: Full MRIQC output directory (derivatives, IQM JSON and reports).
MRIQC individual HTML report for the input image.
TSV table (regressors.tsv) of the image quality metrics computed by MRIQC.

parameters.description: BIDS data folder MRIQC is run on ('func'); fixed for this App and not meant to be changed.
